Built-in colour theme notices
=============================

Grimalkin includes colour values derived from these upstream projects:

- Dracula for Ghostty
  https://github.com/dracula/ghostty
  revision b0e64590232331d9837c82cc1c5138e11ea39f76
  Copyright (c) 2023 Dracula Theme

- Nord and Nord Terminal.app
  https://github.com/nordtheme/nord
  https://github.com/nordtheme/terminal-app
  revisions 1cef71605416a222e57225b544540ce0fcec18d4 and
  5700e5e8113fdd23da89405c7ee8d97ae95bcf46
  Copyright (c) 2016-present Sven Greb <development@svengreb.de>

- Gruvbox
  https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox
  revision 5d15b2765f59754d7ac263c88a0f6e3e58124951
  Author: Pavel Pertsev <morhetz@gmail.com>

- Solarized
  https://github.com/altercation/solarized
  revision 62f656a02f93c5190a8753159e34b385588d5ff3
  Copyright (c) 2011 Ethan Schoonover

- Catppuccin and Catppuccin for Windows Terminal
  https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin
  https://github.com/catppuccin/windows-terminal
  revisions d09787dd98ca6fba08af5ef2ae94a7e09f17daca and
  4d8bb2f00fb86927a98dd3502cdec74a76d25d7b
  Copyright (c) 2021 Catppuccin

- Tokyo Night
  https://github.com/tokyo-night/tokyo-night-vscode-theme
  revision 7c0f11eaef322f293621ca7befe462214b7ea468
  Copyright (c) 2018-present Enkia

- Rosé Pine for Ghostty
  https://github.com/rose-pine/ghostty
  revision d8b4ec06e0cde80fb2bfbf59021ff0a332c77388
  Copyright (c) Rosé Pine
